title: Grounded Gates: gold audit true green, anti-rotation grading, design system v1

ciFast.note: Fast verification (which now includes audit:gold:ci) is claimed only after v0.15.186 is pushed and the GitHub Actions run passes.

deploy.note: Pages deploy is not claimed until the pushed v0.15.186 release completes its deploy run.

ciDeep.note: The full strict deep-proof quality gate (blueprint matrix, deliverables, gold 40/40, expert audit, proof packet) passed locally in strict mode before this release; Deep proof on GitHub runs on its normal schedule.

liveProvider.note: Prompt-cache hits (cachedInputTokens > 0) and the wall-clock effect of warm-first dispatch, higher concurrency, and the stall watchdog require a fresh live provider round (crucible or deployed audit) after deploy.

manualHuman.note: No external instructor approval is claimed by this release.

claims.summary: All 26 gold-audit blockers fixed at their roots (grounding-echo domain vocabulary, colon-echo seam anchoring, compactSourceCue leading-clause join, artifact-reference head-noun derivation with pool dedup); full 40-sample audit passes with zero blockers.
proofCommands: rg -n "is not an echo|artifact 1. must not match inside" src/lib/compiledLanguageFinalizer.js

claims.summary: Grader v1.8.0: boilerplate net covers studyGuides/lessonPlans/quizBank/assignments at calibrated 0.35/0.7 bars, texture weight 10 to 25, texture below 60 is a P1; the mail-merge fixture grades 74/C while the calibration set stays 97-98/A.

Short-answer/essay projection degrades to term-example/anchor-fact grounding and misconception-versus-correction essay prompts when the course-layer scenario or discussion is missing, so genome-linked lessons stop shipping template-only assessment surfaces.

Fast verification runs audit:gold:ci — a 10-sample slice covering all seven historically fragile samples and the 5/8/14 scopes — on every push, closing the silent-red release hole documented in the v0.15.3 field audit and reproduced at v0.15.185.

Kernel chunk prompts are byte-identical (courseLevel schema moved to the user prompt) with warm-first dispatch on both Pass B and prose paths; feature concurrency 3 to 4; open-readings prefetch overlaps authoring; finish retries run per-feature-group in parallel; a 120s stream inactivity watchdog converts stalls into retries.

Semantic tokens (accent/status/gbrand CSS variables mapped into Tailwind), type scale with a 10px floor, Button/Card/StatusBadge primitives, and the declutter pass (single Configure banner, quiet autosave text, empty Type column hidden, Content tab naming) — all gated by tests/design-system.test.js.
proofCommands: rg -n "third nag on one screen" src/components/chat/ChatPanel.jsx

knownRemainingTargets: A live provider round must confirm cachedInputTokens > 0 in the run digest and the wall-clock effect of warm-first dispatch, concurrency 4, and the stall watchdog.
Model downshift routing for nativeSkeleton/voicePass/genomeExtract is designed but deferred: it needs a per-provider cheap-tier sibling map with availability fallback before it can ship safely.
The pre-existing deliverable-terminal-states E2E failure (features stuck in streaming when one errors, present at v0.15.185) is under investigation in a separate branch.

Design-system migration continues opportunistically: raw slate utilities, DependencyMap SVG palette, the changelog page's violet theme, and the legacy dark-mode !important overrides shrink as components are touched.
